note: How far the air in a closed car rises above the outside temperature as it stands in the sun, in degrees Fahrenheit by minutes, as the study's author gives the averages. 'later_f' are his ranges for longer stays. 'ambient_f' is the span of days measured; 'cracked_f' is the most that windows left slightly open changed it.
source: Jan Null, San Jose State University, 'Vehicle Heating Dynamics' (noheatstroke.org/vehicle_heating.htm), read 2026-11-12: 16 clear days in 2002, a dark blue mid-size sedan with a grey interior; published as McLaren, Null and Quinn, Pediatrics 2005
